metadata.name: Indonesia Property Sample Dataset
metadata.description: Associative JSON property dataset grouped by 36 Indonesian provinces. Each province contains 220 mixed property records by transaction type and building type.
metadata.note: Mock/sample data for development, chatbot testing, frontend portfolio testing, and backend import testing.
metadata.image_strategy: Each property references one shared PNG image based on building_type.
metadata.selection_method: Balanced selection across provinces, using evenly spaced records from each province to preserve mixed building_type and transaction_type.
